t1.model_change: Confirmed unit mix: obs 96.93 = 82*(1+1.20462*f) -> hidden lb fraction f ~ 0.15. Clean-data mean = 82 kg. Same defect family as b1/b2: ingestion merges sheets without unit normalization.

t2.model_change: Confirmed c1 pattern: Random(999) constructed inside replicate loop -> all 2000 resamples identical -> CI width 0. Fix: seed once. Correct width = 2*1.96*sd/sqrt(n) = 0.62.

t3.model_change: Confirmed d-family: mean_latency() silently drops top decile of a right-skewed distribution -> 21.1 vs true mean exp(3+0.32)=27.66. Fix: report p90-trimmed and full mean as separate named metrics.

t4.model_change: Frame was equal-FUEL, not equal-distance: total miles / total gallons = (20g1*... ) -> arithmetic mean 30 mpg. e1 lesson generalized: mpg aggregation depends on what is held equal; the number is meaningless without the weighting frame.
